pr_title: Support extra stuff in the Content-Type header via Mime registration
pr_body:
I'm not sure a better way to describe this, but we need to set extra
stuff in the Content-Type header and we're doing it via Mime
registration so that we can have the "html_fragment" method on the
respond_to type.  This worked in Rails 5.2, but it's broken in 6.0

In the future, I think we should probably give `register` a block that
takes the response object so we can do more interesting and complex
stuff without doing weird string manipulation.  But this patch fixes the
issue we have today.

Fixes #36993

issue_context.title: Fragment content type issues in Rails 6.0
issue_context.body: We're seeing an issue in Rails 6.0 that we actually found previously in 5.2 but didn't follow up with on 6.0. In #35549 the content type parser changed and now we're seeing the wrong headers getting returned which results in our error messages displaying as "Something went wrong" rather than "Username is already taken". The error is visible in the response on the browser console but doesn't make it to the front-end. Here are the headers in 5.2: And 6.0 And here's a repro script @tenderlove wrote up demonstrating the issue: ```ruby # frozen_string_literal: true require "abstract_unit" require "active_support/log_subscriber/test_helper" class RespondToController < ActionController::Base layout :set_layout def my_html_fragment respond_to do |type| type.html_fragment { render body: "neat" } end end end class RespondToControllerTest < ActionController::TestCase def setup super @request.host = "www.example.com" Mime::Type.register("text/html; fragment", :html_fragment) end def teardown super Mime::Type.unregister(:html_fragment) end def test_html_fragment @request.accept = "text/html; fragment" get :my_html_fragment assert_equal "text/html; fragment; charset=utf-8", @response.headers["Content-Type"] assert_equal "neat", @response.body end end ``` We're not sure exactly how to fix this yet but wanted to open an issue until we figure it out. cc/ @tenderlove @jhawthorn @cpruitt @alimi @rafaelfranca @kamipo cc original author/ @r7kamura
